page.overview:
Who is Wihuwte?

Wihuwte is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is the deputy chief of Dustwatch and, using the pseudonym of Vulture, he is also the leader of the bandits called the Daybreakers.

Approximately one year prior, Wihuwte using the pseudonym "the Vulture", challenged the leaders of the Daybreakers—Zekowa, Kwikana, and Liwine—to a duel. He appeared with his henchmen and defeated Zekowa and his companions. Wihuwte seized control of the Daybreakers and transformed them into a band of criminals. At first, the members of the group feared Wihuwte and obeyed his orders without question. When Wihuwte demonstrated that, by leveraging his position as deputy chief of the Dustwatch, he could ensure their crimes went unpunished and allow them to amass wealth, he fully won them over.

Zekowa and his friends eventually concluded that the only way to stop him was to challenge him to a duel. When the day of the duel arrived, Wihuwte appeared with the Dustwatch and ordered the arrest of Kwikana and Liwine on charges of theft, setting their bail at a sum no one could possibly afford..}}

Outraged by the unjust imprisonment of his companions, Zekowa confronted Wihuwte, the deputy chief of the Dustwatch. Wihuwte mocked Zekowa, claiming he had evidence that Zekowa's friends had committed the theft and declaring the investigation closed. As a frustrated Zekowa was about to raise his gun at Wihuwte, he was interrupted by Estinien preventing Wihuwte from having an excuse to arrest Zekowa. Kemakka, the sheriff of the Dustwatch, asked what was happening, Wihuwte merely told Kemakka not to worry and that he would keep an eye on Zekowa..}}
